start.title: How do I get started?
start.body: Register your account and create your first business in onboarding. The business, your membership and a disabled agent are saved. Afterwards configure its context and connect WhatsApp. Customers and orders use persistent data; dashboard and reports keep independent demos.

messages.title: Are messages sent to WhatsApp?
messages.body: Conversations shows live incoming messages received by the webhook for the connected number. It requires the inbox migration and Meta's messages subscription. The latest view refreshes every 10 seconds without importing earlier history. OWNER/ADMIN can take control and reply with text within 24 hours, or return the thread to AI for new messages. AI requires a configured service, enabled agent and published context. Message origin and job state are shown, not earlier external sends or delivery receipts. Dates are displayed in UTC.

agent.title: How does the agent preview work?
agent.body: The preview shows the name, tone and greeting you are editing. Saving persists the configuration in PostgreSQL. With an enabled agent, published context and configured AI service, new texts can generate and send automatic replies; the preview does not call the model. Edit and publish the extensive commercial context in Businesses.

catalog.title: Can I edit the catalog?
catalog.body: Yes. In the “With data” scenario you can create, edit and delete products, search by name or reference and filter by availability. References must be unique. Products included in orders cannot be deleted: deactivate them to retain history. There are no automatic inventory adjustments.

orders.title: What do the metrics and statuses mean?
orders.body: Revenue and average order value only include paid and shipped orders. Pending and cancelled orders do not generate revenue. Periods end on June 14, 2026, a fixed date to make the demo reproducible. Statuses can be changed freely; no payments or shipments are processed.

privacy.title: Where is the data stored?
privacy.body: Accounts, businesses, context, catalog, agent and real messages are stored in PostgreSQL. Context and messages have no application-level encryption or automatic purge. Customers, orders and reports use in-memory fixtures. Local drafts are discarded on reload or business switch.

businesses.title: How do I manage several businesses?
businesses.body: Use the selector below the logo to switch business or create another. Each business has its own configuration, catalog, agent and WhatsApp. New products use its currency; currency cannot change after products exist. No prices are converted and demo reports remain in PEN/UTC.

reset.title: How do I explore empty and error states?
reset.body: Scenarios only affect demo modules, never real customers, orders or catalog. Use the “Scenario” selector where available in demos. “Empty collections” hides collections and makes configuration read-only. “Read error” shows a simulated failure; “Retry” will keep failing until you switch to “With data”. Switching scenarios discards open drafts but keeps saved changes. “Reset demo” restores all business data and discards drafts; it does not affect onboarding.
